steps.content: 08:48 The conference hall in the center of the square
Howls of anguish swirl around the conference hall. Zoya casts aside an unconscious gangster and feels distant vibrations coming up from the ground.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: I've told them this is my business only, those guys... They're holding me back.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: I should make quick work of this, or they'll be down before I come to their aid.
As she speaks, Zoya steps over the elite sheriffs lying haphazardly on the floor. She grabs Burns, who has been knocked over by the impact, and picks him up from the floor.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Now tell me about this friend of yours, Mr. Burns.
